title: 駐車場遮断バー
description: 回転軸、釣合いおもり、モーター収納箱と受け支柱を備えた下がった状態の遮断バー。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Lowered parking boom with pivot hub, arm clamp, counterweight, service cabinet and receiving cradle. Static visual assembly, not an operational access-control system. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
